name: Reject stamp
what: A big rubber stamp slams down at an angle - it falls from large and out of focus, hits with a camera jolt and a spatter of ink - and settles, its ink rough at the edges and worn in patches. NOPE, WRONG, REJECTED, APPROVED: any word, any ink colour.
origin: A MotionLab original for a common need (a verdict stamped over a talking head), rebuilt in our HyperFrames way from the look and motion of an MIT-licensed Python effect (claude-video-effects, reject-stamp); 2026-10-27
motion: f0-f6 the stamp falls from 1.9x to its size (accelerating: a drop), turning 7 degrees into its tilt, out of focus and casting a shadow that tightens, fading in over f0-f3; f6 the hit: it squashes 3.5 % (2 f) and settles back (back.out, 8 f), the ink spatter is flung out round the frame (4 f, power3.out) and the camera jolts and rings out over 16 frames; in the hold the ink soaks in a little (a 1 % swell, a little lighter); at the end it fades (power2.in, 6 f)

tracks.name: fall
tracks.what: the stamp falls from 1.9x, out of focus, turning into its tilt

tracks.name: hit
tracks.what: it squashes a hair and settles; the ink spatters out

tracks.what: the camera jolts and rings out

min_why: the slam and the camera jolt ring out before it fades
